claim_scope: processing utility responds to the Consumer protocol; the three protocols differ in fit protocol as well as model structure, so this is NOT a 'only the model structure changed' reading, and the C-c arm speaks only for the deterministic low-rank reconstruction family (no AE / TimesNet extrapolation)

held_fixed.acting_bytes: the training substrate only; Query bytes raw
held_fixed.metric: event F1 on the eval region, zero-tolerance overlap matching, merge_events point mapping
held_fixed.scoring_layer: consumers.aegists_iforest_v1, shared by all three arms

c_a_iforest.protocol: per series, unlabeled, window 20, one fit per (series, program)

spec.detector: sliding-window IsolationForest, one model per series
spec.standardization: scalar mean/std from P(B) only, applied unchanged to the untouched Query; std == 0 is replaced by 1
spec.query_rule: decision_function(window) < 0, the threshold frozen at fit time by contamination; never refitted on the Query
spec.event_rule: consecutive anomalous points merge into one predicted event
spec.matching: greedy one-to-one by row overlap against NAB windows; a window is the set of rows whose timestamp falls inside it
spec.primary_metric: macro average of per-series event F1
spec.borrowed_from: a-evolve/AegisTS/Error_Detection/detectors/models/IForest.py -- window+IsolationForest structure only; not its model-selection stack, and not its train/predict normalization asymmetry

c_b_supervised.protocol: pooled over the roster, labelled held-in rows, feature window 49, one fit per program

classifier.classifier: weighted closed-form ridge over the single feature z_t
classifier.feature: f1 = z_t = detect(values, window=49, threshold=3.5)['scores'], one pass through the T0 detector's own code path; explicit 49/3.5 (the frozen fallback parameters), never the 25/4.0 file defaults; no re-standardization
classifier.standardization: none -- the feature already is a robust z-score
classifier.label: 1 at every ledger event point (all 3 points of a burst), else 0
classifier.positive_class_weight: N_neg / N_pos, computed on the rows that enter the fit (undefined-z points are excluded first)
classifier.solver: weighted normal equations, np.linalg.solve, mirroring evaluation/benchmark_v02/trainers.fit_closed_form (intercept column last and unpenalized)
classifier.decision: score > 0.5 flags the point; an undefined z never flags
classifier.fallback: none -- v3 is single-shot; a gate miss closes the family

abstention.training: a point whose z is undefined does not enter the fit; exclusions are counted and attributed to warm_up / zero_scale / non_finite
abstention.query: a point whose z is undefined is forced to not flag
abstention.auprc: computed over the finite-feature points only; the undefined-point count is reported
abstention.ledger_events_all_unscoreable: naturally counted as missed detections; no special handling
abstention.never: a non-finite score is never converted to zero

score.event_merging: maximal runs of consecutive flagged points (T0)
score.main_metric: per-series Query event F1, macro-averaged across series (v2 execution-convention ruling); the pooled F1 is reported alongside as a secondary reading
score.secondary_metric: AUPRC from the ridge scores, threshold-free
score.scoring_parts: anomaly_detection_v1.predicted_events / match_events / score_events, imported, not re-implemented

spec.siting_rule: an experiment instrument, not a Harness part: nothing under methods/ttha imports this module and this module imports nothing from the Harness under study

c_c_pca.protocol: per series, unlabeled, window 20, one fit per (series, program)

spec.family_claim_cap: readings taken with this Consumer speak for the deterministic low-rank reconstruction family only; they do not extrapolate to autoencoders, TimesNet or any learned/iterative reconstruction model
spec.detector: sliding-window low-rank projection, one model per series
spec.standardization: scalar mean/std from the training substrate only, applied unchanged to the untouched Query; std == 0 is replaced by 1 -- the same function the in-service IForest Consumer uses
spec.centering: 20-vector column mean of the training window matrix
spec.decomposition: numpy.linalg.svd, the exact LAPACK factorisation; no randomized SVD, no truncated iterative solver, no power iteration, no seed
spec.rank_basis: a column-centered 20-point window of a locally smooth or quasi-periodic series is spanned by a level/slope-residual mode plus one periodic pair; rank 3 is the smallest rank carrying that family.  Fixture-gated at explained-variance ratio >= 0.90 on a clean synthetic substrate, then frozen -- never scanned on Yahoo
spec.score: root-mean-square reconstruction residual; higher = more anomalous
spec.threshold: the 0.90 quantile of the training substrate's residual distribution, frozen at fit time; never refitted on the Query
spec.threshold_basis: parity with the in-service IForest Consumer's contamination = 0.1: both Consumers carry the same 10% frozen training-time alarm budget, so a delta between them is not an alarm-rate artefact
spec.query_rule: residual > frozen threshold; the Query bytes are never written
spec.scoring_layer: merge_events / match_events / event_f1 / auprc / background_alarm_rate imported from consumers.aegists_iforest_v1 -- not re-implemented, so all three M0-C Consumers score identically
spec.primary_metric: macro average of per-series event F1

true_held_out: remaining 41 sealed series; unread this book

c1.rule: some program p with one of (iforest, pca) macro delta >= +bar and the other <= -bar

side_flag.rule: some cleaning program drops the supervised macro recall by at least 0.005

preregistered_predictions.prediction: cleaning damages the positive class (recall drops)

frozen_parameter_basis.rank_basis: a column-centered 20-point window of a locally smooth or quasi-periodic series is spanned by a level/slope-residual mode plus one periodic pair; rank 3 is the smallest rank carrying that family.  Fixture-gated at explained-variance ratio >= 0.90 on a clean synthetic substrate, then frozen -- never scanned on Yahoo
frozen_parameter_basis.threshold_basis: parity with the in-service IForest Consumer's contamination = 0.1: both Consumers carry the same 10% frozen training-time alarm budget, so a delta between them is not an alarm-rate artefact

realized_explained_variance_ratio.reading: reported as a diagnostic only; the rank stays 3 and is not re-picked from these numbers

cell_level_sign_contrast.not_a_judgment: C1 is judged on the pre-registered macro bar only; this per-cell count was not pre-registered, opens nothing and closes nothing

supervised_training_evidence.not_the_preregistered_flag: the pre-registered side flag reads eval-side macro recall; this is the training-side positive-row census and was not pre-registered

obligations.sealed_series_note: the roster is the first 24 files of the frozen Yahoo list in lexicographic order; the remaining 41 are never opened here

cost.mask_fit_policy: not run this book; #42j artifact read only
